items.title: Identifying Code Duplication and the main Function

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Identifying Code Duplication; The main Function (PDF 54-55, printed 51-52).

blocks.title: Code duplication
blocks.text: Code duplication means the same code is repeated in several places; it makes maintenance harder and causes bugs, so finding and removing it is an important part of modular programming.

blocks.title: The main function
blocks.text: The main function marks where a program starts. It is usually called inside a block that checks whether the file is being run directly or imported as a module.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)

blocks.text: main() runs only when the file is executed directly, not when it is imported elsewhere; this setup is useful in large projects with many modules.
